mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, SPEC_DESC AS MATERIAL_DESC, SPECIFICATIONS, PRO_SIZE, EMBRYO_CODE, EMBRYO_DESC, PATTERN, HIERARCHY, SPEED_LEVEL AS SPEED, SECTION_WIDTH, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE, BRAND, MES_MATERIAL_CATEGORY, MES_MATERIAL_SUBCATEGORY, MES_MATERIAL_CATE_NAME, MES_MATERIAL_SUBCAT_NAME, SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM MES_BAS_MATERIAL WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, MOLD_SLEEVE AS MOULD_SET_CODE, TOTAL_NUM AS TOTAL_QTY, MACHINE_NUM AS MACHINE_QTY, WAREHOUSE_NUM AS ON_HAND_QTY, OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_QTY, PLAN_OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_PLAN_QTY, DOWN_MACHINE_NUM AS DEPLANE_QTY, FORCE_OUT_NUM AS FORCE_OUT_BOUND_QTY, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM MOLD_SHELL_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE AS OUTBOUND_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, TYPE_CODE AS MATERIAL_TYPE, MATERIAL_NAME AS MATERIAL_DESC, STOCK_NUM AS OUTBOUND_QTY, UNIT, DATA_VERSION, FACTORY_CODE, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM ORI_MATERIAL_OUT_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT ID, ONLINE_DATE, CX_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, SPEC_DESC, EMBRYO_SPEC, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM CX_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT ID, ONLINE_DATE, LH_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, SPEC_DESC, LR_MOLDS, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT ID, DEV_CODE, PRECISION_TYPE, OPER_TIME, FIRST_WASH_TIME, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM DEV_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT ID, OBTAIN_TIME, LH_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT2, BRAND, REMARK, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_REPAIR_CAPSULE WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT ID, LH_CODE, OPER_TIME, FIRST_WASH_TIME, SECOND_WASH_TIME, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MOULD_CLEAN_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
